rubrics.justification: Describes a good-quality blastocyst with plausible ICM and TE assessment and appropriately notes uncertainty from a single static image; minor inconsistency in calling it early-to-full while also accepting reported 3AA limits precision.
Thoroughly integrates maternal age, prior IVF outcomes, tubal factor, ovarian reserve, sperm quality, BMI, endometrium, and lifestyle factors with embryo morphology and prognosis.

Reasoning is logical and well structured, with prognosis tied mainly to age-related aneuploidy despite good morphology; only minor issues such as slightly loose statements about implantation versus clinical pregnancy/live birth metrics.

Recommendations are broadly consistent with IVF practice and Gardner grading principles, including SET, uterine evaluation, and discussion of PGT-A/RPL workup; slight overstatement of PGT-A benefit prevents a perfect score.
Provides clear next steps for current transfer and contingency planning, including lifestyle modification, luteal support adherence, uterine assessment, RPL evaluation, and future cycle strategy.
